description: Codegen + end-to-end pipeline + CLI + SEO verification. Depends on FEAT-001's parsers/loaders/evaluator. Implements the three emitters (complete static HTML with build-time-resolved interpolations and deterministic data-adx-c scoping; CSS transform that expands abbreviated props, resolves tokens.*, auto-scopes, and passes media queries; hydration-only ES-module glue per Option 1), wires them into a compileComponent/checkComponent pipeline, exposes the `adx build` / `adx check` CLI (only), and verifies the SEO contract on real emitted HTML. Corresponds to plan.md items 10-15.
steps: Read docs/adx-grammar.md (AST shape, section 8) and .agents/tasks/context.json FIRST. Implement src/codegen/scope.ts (deterministic scopeId = short hash of component name + relative path) and src/codegen/html.ts (emitHtml(ast, ctx): string): resolve all {{interp}} and :prop at build time, apply :if/:else (omit falsy), expand :for in loop scope, emit <slot> as data-adx-slot="<name>" placeholder, add data-adx-c="<scopeId>" to owned elements and stable data-adx-b hooks on nodes with bindings/events, preserve semantic tags, self-close void elements, leave zero `{{` in output. (plan item 10)

Implement src/codegen/css.ts (transformCss(src, ctx): string): strip `@use tokens;`, expand abbreviated props (pad/bg/radius/size/weight + documented layout/visual/typography set), resolve every tokens.* via the token loader, prefix each selector with [data-adx-c="<id>"], pass @media through resolving tokens.breakpoint-*. Unknown token throws the EXACT `[ADX] style.adx.css:<line> - Unknown token "tokens.space-5" (available: 0,1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16)` error. (plan item 11)

Implement src/codegen/glue.ts (emitGlue(ast, behavior, ctx): string): ES module that imports behavior exports, calls setup(props) once, selects existing DOM by data-adx-c/data-adx-b (never rebuilds DOM), attaches each @event to its handler, and re-runs only affected bindings/text on handler invocation. No shared-runtime import, no vDOM, no createElement DOM construction. (plan item 12)

Implement src/compile.ts: compileComponent(dir, opts): {html, css, glue} and checkComponent(dir) running manifest -> structure parse -> behavior scan -> tokens -> emit; check validates and emits all stages but writes nothing. (plan item 13)

Implement src/cli.ts (shebang `#!/usr/bin/env node`): parse argv for `build <componentDir> [--out dist] [--tokens tokens/design-tokens.json]` (writes dist/<name>/index.html|style.css|glue.js) and `check <componentDir>` (prints OK or the [ADX] error, non-zero exit on failure). No other subcommands. Confirm package.json bin -> dist/cli.js. (plan item 14)

Add Vitest tests: test/html-emit.test.ts (UserCard HTML snapshot: resolved text, :if omission, :for expansion, slot placeholder, zero `{{`), test/css-transform.test.ts (expand+scope+resolve; tokens.space-5 exact error; breakpoint-md -> 768px), test/glue-emit.test.ts (valid ESM, imports onClick, references scope hooks, no createElement), test/compile.test.ts (end-to-end three artifacts; checkComponent passes on valid fixture, throws right [ADX] on a broken copy), test/seo-contract.test.ts (emitted HTML has no `{{`, correct semantic tags + heading order). (plan items 10-13,15)

findings:
FEAT-002 complete. All verification green: `npm run build && npm test && npm run lint` pass (77 tests, 11 files, 0 lint errors). `node dist/cli.js build fixtures/user-card --out dist` writes dist/user-card/{index.html,style.css,glue.js}; `node dist/cli.js check fixtures/user-card` prints OK exit 0; dist/user-card/index.html has zero `{{`. Broken copy (tokens.space-4 -> space-5) makes `check` exit 1 with EXACT `[ADX] style.adx.css:5 - Unknown token "tokens.space-5" (available: 0,1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16)`. glue.js contains no createElement.

NEW SOURCE FILES
- src/codegen/scope.ts: scopeId(name, locationPath) = `c` + first 7 hex of sha256(`${name}\0${locationPath}`) -> 8-char token, deterministic/byte-stable. bindingId(scope, n) = `${scope}-${n}`.
- src/codegen/context.ts: CodegenContext { componentName, scopeId, scope:EvalScope, tokens:TokenTable, behavior:BehaviorApi, manifest:Manifest }. Shared by all three emitters.
- src/codegen/html.ts: emitHtml(ast:Node[], ctx):HtmlEmitResult { html:string, hooks:BindingHook[] }. Resolves {{}}/:prop via evaluate() at build time; :if/:else paired by element-sibling position (whitespace-only text does not break pairing); :for unrolled with innermost-first locals frame ({item},{index}); non-array iterable -> emits nothing; <slot> -> `<slot class=.. data-adx-slot="name" data-adx-c=..></slot>`. Every owned element gets data-adx-c; nodes with bindings OR events get data-adx-b="<scope>-<n>" (counter increments in emit order) AND push a BindingHook {id, events:[{event,handler}], bindings:[name]}. void/self-closing tags emit `<tag ... />`. Text + attr values HTML-escaped. null/undefined binding value -> attribute omitted. BindingHook/HtmlEmitResult exported.
- src/codegen/css.ts: transformCss(src, ctx):string. Brace-matching walk with ABSOLUTE source offsets threaded through so unknown-token line is always correct (incl. inside @media). Strips `@use ...;`. PROP_ALIASES: pad->padding, bg->background, radius->border-radius, size->font-size, weight->font-weight, shadow->box-shadow, w->width, h->height, font->font-family, leading->line-height, tracking->letter-spacing (others verbatim). Resolves tokens.* via ctx.tokens; unknown -> adxError(style.adx.css,line,`Unknown token "<ref>" (available: <availableSpacing()>)`). SCOPING = ATTACH, not prefix: each simple selector gets the attribute after its compound and before pseudos, e.g. `.card` -> `.card[data-adx-c="id"]`, `.card:hover` -> `.card[data-adx-c="id"]:hover`, descendants `.a .b` each scoped (because data-adx-c sits on every owned element; a prefix descendant combinator would miss the root). @media passes through with breakpoint tokens resolved to px.
- src/codegen/glue.ts: emitGlue(hooks:BindingHook[], ctx):string. ESM: `import { setup, <handlers...> } from "./behavior.js";` (handlers = unique sorted event handler names). Builds props from manifest defaults, merges globalThis.__ADX_PROPS__[name] overrides, sets globalThis.emit (bubbling CustomEvent on root) BEFORE calling setup(props) once (behavior handlers call a free emit()). Selects root via `[data-adx-c="<scope>"]`, byHook(id) via `[data-adx-b]`, addEventListener(event, e => handler(state, event)). Exports { state, props }. NO createElement/innerHTML/vDOM/runtime import.
- src/compile.ts: compileComponent(dir, {tokensPath?}):{html,css,glue,manifest}. Pipeline manifest -> parseStructure -> scanBehavior -> loadTokens -> emit. Build-time EvalScope = manifest prop DEFAULTS used as BOTH state and props (setup is never executed — pure compiler). Default tokensPath = resolve('../tokens/design-tokens.json') (CWD compiler/). html is wrapped in a full crawlable document: <!DOCTYPE>, lang=en, <title>/<meta description>/canonical/OG/Twitter from manifest.seo (fallback to name), optional JSON-LD when seo.schema set, component markup inside <main>, glue loaded as `<script type=module src=glue.js>` AFTER </head> (never blocking). checkComponent(dir, opts) = compileComponent then discard (writes nothing).
- src/cli.ts: shebang node. parseArgs supports `build`/`check` only + `--out` (default dist) + `--tokens`. build writes <out>/<dirBasename>/index.html|style.css|glue.js (OUTPUT FOLDER = component DIR BASENAME, e.g. fixtures/user-card -> user-card, NOT lowercased manifest name) and prints `Built <Name> -> <dir>`. check prints OK (exit 0) or writes the error message to stderr (exit 1). Any other/missing command -> usage + exit 1. Errors caught and surfaced as their `[ADX] ...` message.

index.ts re-exports: scopeId, bindingId, emitHtml, transformCss, emitGlue, compileComponent, checkComponent + types BindingHook, HtmlEmitResult, CodegenContext, CompileOptions, CompiledComponent.
